title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst
description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal - To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

About the role
This role is the analytical and operational link between AssetWatch ’s business stakeholders and the Revenue Systems delivery team. The right person brings genuine business analysis instincts - the ability to surface requirements, resolve competing priorities, and translate complex business needs into something a development team can execute - alongside the organizational discipline to keep a fast-moving sprint cadence on track.
What's the opportunity
Requirements Gathering and Business Analysis
You will lead structured discovery sessions with stakeholders across Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Customer Success Operations, Engineering, and Product - not just attending them but facilitating them. That means surfacing unstated assumptions, identifying conflicting requirements before they reach development, and documenting what was agreed to with enough precision that the team can build from it without circling back. You will translate those conversations into well-formed user stories with clear acceptance criteria, evaluate solution options against real business constraints, and flag trade-offs before work begins.
Stakeholder Alignment and Conflict Resolution
Multiple teams will often bring competing priorities and different interpretations of what a system should do. You will own the alignment work - getting the right people in the room, making trade-offs visible, and resolving conflicts before they become delivery delays. That includes keeping sprint commitments transparent to dependent teams and managing expectations proactively when scope or timelines need to shift. This role operates across many teams and inbound requests simultaneously - strong organizational habits and the ability to carry multiple priorities forward at once without losing momentum on any of them are part of what makes someone successful here.
Process Improvement and UAT
You will document current-state business processes, identify opportunities for automation and workflow improvement, and own the full UAT lifecycle for every enhancement before it reaches production. That means writing test scripts, coordinating business reviewers, triaging defects, and confirming sign-off before any deployment goes live.
Sprint Operations and User Support
You will manage the Jira backlog, run sprint planning and daily standups, follow up before sprint deadlines, and send action items and release notes after each deployment. You will also triage inbound Salesforce support requests through the team’s Slack channel, acknowledge requests promptly, route issues appropriately, and keep stakeholders informed throughout.
What we're looking for

• 3+ years in a BSA, Revenue Operations, or Salesforce-adjacent role in a B2B SaaS environment

• Demonstrated experience facilitating requirements sessions and writing user stories with acceptance criteria

• Comfortable navigating competing stakeholder priorities and resolving cross-team conflicts

• Strong written communication with an instinct for documenting decisions and process

• Proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously and maintain pace across all of them

• Agile sprint management experience with Jira

• Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ/NUE, NetSuite, or Boomi is a plus

We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities - and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

This is a full-time, on-site role based at our property downtown Los Angeles, with no remote or hybrid option.

The Role

Kasa offers flexible accommodations for guests in dozens of markets nationwide. We partner with multifamily and hospitality property owners to offer various unit types in our portfolio, including short-term rental apartments, apart-hotels, and traditional hotel rooms across price and luxury tiers. The Sales Manager is a role that will be laser-focused on gaining corporate and group business who will use Kasa as their preferred accommodations for our properties throughout (Single Market/Property).

College Admissions Consultants offer personalized, one-on-one guidance to students and families throughout their high school years, helping them confidently navigate the college application and admissions process. Additionally, they provide expert support in crafting compelling application materials, including essays, resumes, and preparation for interviews.

description:
Role Title: Senior Electronics Quality Engineer
Role Type: Contractor

micro1 is engaging Senior Electronics Quality Engineers to contribute expert knowledge to a customer's project focused on advanced electronics assembly and inspection. Preferred Qualifications

• Extensive expertise in IPC-A-610 and IPC/WHMA-A-620 inspection criteria; IPC CIS/CIT certification strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience reviewing Gerber data and utilizing PCB CAM software for manufacturability and quality assurance.

• Proficiency in SMT processes, AOI defect analysis, and remediation of false calls in automated inspection systems.

• Direct involvement in counterfeit component screening per AS6081, with knowledge of risk indicators and mitigation strategies.

• Hands-on skills with semiconductor inspection tools such as C-SAM and X-ray, alongside familiarity with MIL-STD-883 procedures.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, ensuring clarity in documentation and knowledge transfer.

title: Backend Engineer, MTA
description:
Resend is building the most accessible email platform for developers. As we’ve grown to 4M+ users and continue to onboard thousands of new users every day, the pressure of maintaining a safe place for good senders continues to build.

This role is fully remote-based in Americas or European time zones, with some expected travel for team off-sites, conferences, meetups, and more.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL…

- Build and operate Resend’s email transport infrastructure

- Work on SMTP delivery, MTA systems, routing, retries, backoff strategies, and delivery controls

- Design systems for domain-level, provider-level, customer-level, and IP-level throttling

- Build infrastructure for shared IP pools, dedicated IPs, warmup execution, and reputation-aware routing

- Improve how Resend classifies bounces, deferrals, transient failures, hard failures, and delivery outcomes

- Build tools that help the team debug delivery issues by customer, domain, mailbox provider, route, IP, message type, and event

- Help design systems that make sending behavior safer, more observable, and easier to operate

- Translate reputation strategy into backend systems

- Participate in incident response for sending, provider, and deliverability-sensitive issues

- Be on-call for critical services

YOU WILL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU...

- Have strong backend engineering experience

- Have worked on email, messaging, notifications, communications, infrastructure, or other high-volume delivery systems

- Understand queues, workers, retries, idempotency, rate limits, backpressure, and distributed systems

- Have experience or strong interest in SMTP, MTAs, DNS, bounces, deferrals, DNS, IP pools, and mailbox-provider behavior

- Care about reliability, observability, operational excellence, and reducing blast radius

- Have low ego, high ownership, and strong taste for simple systems

YOU WILL BE AN EXCEPTIONAL FIT IF YOU ALSO...

- Have experience working on applications with a high workload

- Know about email best practices, or are willing to learn more about this space

- Are experienced in Typescript and Golang

WHAT IT MEANS TO JOIN THE TEAM:

- Autonomy to "just ship it"

- 100% remote team with flexible working schedules

- Modern tech stack (Typescript, AWS, Go, Postgres, Datadog)

- Honest and low-ego team

- Ownership of problems and solutions

- Comp: $150,000 - $170,000 USD, commensurate with experience

ABOUT RESEND

We are building the modern email sending platform for developers. We care deeply about quality, craft, and the developer experience.

Our fully remote team of 50 spans 15 countries and counting. We're backed by a16z, Y Combinator, and others. Meet the humans → https://resend.com/humans

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “ sensor ”, which is a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network can correlate malicious behavior across multiple machines and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

• Detection and Response Security Software.

• Experience working with teams to ship major features and releases.

Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

This role is remote, so it can be executed globally.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact.

Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges-helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible.

What you will do:

- Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

- Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies.

- Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers.

REQUIREMENTS

- Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity

- Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration.

title: Senior Embedded Software Test Engineer, Onboard Test Automation
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer on the Onboard Test Automation Team at Wayve, you will play a key role in validating onboard software systems before they reach full-vehicle testing. You’ll work across a range of embedded compute platforms and operating systems to ensure software is reliable, integrated, and ready for real-world deployment. This is a high-impact role where your work directly improves software quality and enables faster iteration across multiple teams. You’ll help scale testing by building automated tests and empowering developers to validate their work earlier in the development cycle.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Design, develop, and execute automated tests for onboard software subsystems (OS, middleware, sensors, and integration points)

- Validate software behavior on embedded hardware platforms within hardware-in-the-loop environments

- Collaborate with software engineers to identify test gaps and build coverage for new and existing features

- Debug and triage system-level issues across software and hardware boundaries

- Enable developer self-service testing by contributing to CI pipelines and reusable test frameworks

- Support expansion of test coverage by leveraging existing validation tests and shifting them earlier in the development cycle

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Automated integration and system-level testing for embedded Linux or QNX software.

- Hardware-in-the-loop validation across multiple compute platforms.

- Reliability checks for sensor pipelines, middleware, timing, latency, data integrity, and dropped messages.

- Observability that makes intermittent failures easier to reproduce and diagnose.

- Earlier validation of software changes to reduce risk during full-vehicle testing.

- Test frameworks that improve developer velocity and confidence across Robot Software.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You have experience testing embedded software systems, ideally on Linux or QNX.

- You can develop automated tests in Python, C++, or a similar language.

- You have hands-on experience with embedded hardware and hardware/software interactions.

- You can debug complex system-level problems using logs, metrics, and controlled experiments.

- You understand automation, integration testing, and system validation principles.

- You are comfortable collaborating across software, hardware, and infrastructure teams.

Experience with HiL environments, sensor or data pipelines, CI/CD systems such as Buildkite, robotics, autonomous systems, or real-time software would be valuable.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

If you are genuinely passionate about health and wellness, experienced in remote work, a skilled communicator who thrives on structured processes, and proficient with technology to drive meaningful outcomes, this position may be the ideal opportunity to align your enthusiasm with a rewarding career.
The Role:
At Tribe Wellness Sales, we are devoted to supporting individuals in enhancing their health through high-quality products and services. In this position, you will:

• Conduct outbound calls to our customers, using our established scripts to confidently and clearly book Protocol Review Appointments that focus on health optimization.

• Report to the ASR Director, join daily team stand-ups to foster collaboration, and participate in regular one-on-one meetings with your manager for tailored guidance and development.

• Measure success through key performance indicators: Appointments Set, Appointment Show Rate, and Appointment Outcome. We provide comprehensive training to help you excel in these areas, leveraging your wellness passion to build authentic connections.

Compensation:
The role includes a base pay of $6 per hour, plus a commission of 1% of Gross Profit based on closed appointments. Those who bring genuine enthusiasm and skill can earn substantial incentives, with resources provided to maximize your performance and rewards.
Remote Work Environment:
This fully remote position requires a high-speed, stable internet connection and technical proficiency, including familiarity with Salesforce and VOIP phone systems. Your prior remote work experience will ensure smooth integration into our virtual team.
What We're Looking For:

• A background in appointment setting is a plus, but not required.

• Highly-driven self-starters, motivated by growth opportunities and the drive to meet and exceed goals.

• Excellent verbal and written skills, with top-notch communication and a knack for building genuine connections.

• Ability to work 40 hours per week (8 hours per day) starting at 8 AM CST.

• Reliable internet and equipment, since this role involves frequent phone and video calls requiring clear, uninterrupted conversations.

This means you should have:

• A fast, reliable laptop or desktop with a working mic, camera, and headset to comfortably run our call systems and tools simultaneously.

• Ethernet connection strongly preferred for the most consistent call quality (usually just an inexpensive cable connecting your device to your modem).

• Dedicated internet speed of at least 10 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload, with latency under ~150ms, jitter under ~30ms, and packet loss under ~1%.

Join us if you're ready to play a pivotal role in reshaping the world of men's health and wellness while thriving in a growth-centric global environment with amazing people. If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Apply today and work with a very different type of company.

description: Über uns Kijimea - Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert - u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. title: Product Marketing Manager, Technology Partnerships
description:
What Do We Do?
Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommmerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you - pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it bites.
We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the most actionable AI in commerce - Moby 2 - letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby 2 doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.
The result: more than 65,000 brands like Pressed Juicery, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.
About the role
The Product Marketing Manager, Technology Partnerships will lead product marketing for Triple Whale ’s strategic platform partnerships and growing technology partner ecosystem. This role will sit at the intersection of Product, Partnerships, Sales, Customer Success, and our customers, helping translate shipped capabilities, integrations, and validated measurement proof into clear, compelling stories that resonate across each audience.
A core focus of the role will be bringing partner-related work to market thoughtfully and effectively. This includes supporting go-to-market commitments with strategic platform and advertising partners, as well as helping launch partner-built integrations in a way that clearly communicates their value and impact.
The ideal person will be able to connect commercial priorities, product capabilities, and customer needs, then turn that context into strong messaging, enablement, and launch preparation that helps internal teams, partners, and customers understand what we’re building and why it matters.
What you’ll own

• Develop joint positioning, messaging, and go-to-market narratives that explain partner capabilities, audiences, and customer value.

• Lead launch readiness for partner-built integrations across Product, Partnerships, Partner Marketing, Sales, and CS. Align materials, enablement, dependencies, and responsibilities before activation.

• Own product marketing deliverables for market development fund (MDF) programs, translating commitments into messaging, briefs, content, and enablement with clear scope and deadlines.

title: Team Lead
description:
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

•
Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.

• We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for Boldr impact.

LET’S START WITH OUR VALUES

• Meaningful connections start with AUTHENTICITY

● We do our best work by being CURIOUS
● We grow by remaining DYNAMIC

• Our success combines AMBITIOUS VISION with OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

• At the heart of great partnerships, we’ll always find EMPATHY

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE
As a Team Lead , you are responsible for executing processes defined by the client or management. You will need to efficiently manage a large amount of often sensitive or confidential information. The role will require keen attention to detail while maintaining productivity at defined proficiency levels.
WHY DO WE WANT YOU
We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic, and Authentic.
WHAT WILL YOU DO

• Team Leadership: Supervise and lead a team of team members during the assigned shift. Provide guidance, coaching, and support to ensure team members meet their goals and objectives.

• Quality Assurance: Ensure support and acknowledgment of quality standards aligned with our client and customer experience. Implement quality control procedures and address any quality issues promptly.

• Performance Metrics: Monitor and track key performance metrics, such as agent tasks and responsibilities. Take corrective actions as needed to meet or exceed performance targets.

• Training and Development: Train new associates and provide ongoing training to existing team members to enhance their skills and knowledge. Foster a culture of continuous improvements through weekly 1:1s and impromptu coaching sessions.

• Communication: Maintain open and effective communication channels with team members, other shift leads, and management. Report any issues, escalations, or opportunities for improvement.

• Problem Solving: Address operational challenges and resolve issues that may arise during the shift. Collaborate with other departments to find solutions to complex problems.

• Helpdesk Management: Ensure the helpdesk is managed by checking agent availability and SLA tickets.

• Ensuring you are available as the POC in the management queue to do escalations.

Requirements
WHAT WE’LL LIKE ABOUT YOU
YOU ARE…

• Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr

• An analytical and critical thinker, with an eye for even the most minute of details

● Passionate about client satisfaction
YOU HAVE…

• Bachelor's/College Degree in any field you’re passionate about!

● 1 year of leadership experience.

• 2+ years of Customer Support experience

• Basic knowledge of cloud-based applications such as Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and MS Office applications.

• Familiarity with help desk or ticketing systems (Intercom experience a plus).

• Familiarity with website-building tools, content management systems, or presentation software

• Strong technical aptitude for troubleshooting digital platforms and web-based apps.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• An ability to understand and communicate complex ideas to clients.

• Ability to accept feedback gracefully and with an open mind.

• Customer orientation and ability to adapt/respond to customers with diverse backgrounds.

NICE TO HAVE...

• Knowledge of presentation software (Gamma, PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva).

• Familiarity with AI-powered tools or generative platforms.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Android Design System
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

This is an Android role on Reddit ’s Design System Team. The mission of the Design System Team is to deliver a cohesive, modern and accessible experience across all of Reddit ’s platforms.
As an Android engineer on the Design System Team, you will help evolve Reddit ’s cross-platform design system and UI architecture that powers experiences across the company. You will build reusable components, improve platform capabilities, and help establish frontend patterns that enable product teams to ship high-quality experiences efficiently. This role has broad scope and impact, helping shape the future of frontend development at Reddit .
What You’ll Do :

•
Evolve Reddit ’s cross-platform design system by expanding its capabilities and developing higher-level reusable components that accelerate product development while maintaining consistency and quality.

•
Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, designers, and engineers to ensure the design system and UI infrastructure effectively support real product needs.

•
Improve performance at scale , contributing to Android architecture, rendering patterns, and performance-focused development practices that make performance a built-in feature of the platform.

•
Advance accessibility across the platform , building accessible components, patterns, tooling, and documentation that help teams adopt accessibility best practices by default.

•
Strengthen developer experience , contributing to shared tooling, documentation, and platform improvements that help engineers build reliable, consistent UI across Reddit ’s products.

You Have:

• 6+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of leading cross-functional projects and delivering solutions with broad product impact.

• Experience building and maintaining shared UI infrastructure, such as design systems, component libraries, or frontend infrastructure used across multiple teams.

• Strong experience with modern Android development using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, with expertise in UI architecture, scalable component design, and performance optimization using tools such as Instruments.

• Familiarity with accessibility best practices and an interest in building components, tooling, or documentation that help teams ship accessible experiences by default.

• You embody Reddit ’s core value of “Evolve” - you embrace ambiguity, seek feedback, and continuously improve your craft and the platform you help build.

Benefits:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. title: Member Implementation Advisor
description:
About Better Impact
At Better Impact , we believe technology should make it easier for organizations to do meaningful work. Our software helps nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, and other organizations manage their volunteer programs, streamline operations, and strengthen community engagement.
Backed by The Brydon Group, Better Impact is growing, and we're looking for thoughtful, collaborative people who are excited to help our members get the most out of the technology they use every day.
About the Role
We're looking for a Member Implementation Advisor to help new members successfully launch and adopt Better Impact software.
In this role, you'll be part trainer, part problem-solver, and part trusted guide. You'll work directly with new members to understand their goals, navigate implementation, and build the skills and confidence they need to use our software effectively.
Successful implementation isn't just about getting software up and running. It's about helping people understand how technology can support their work, identifying practical solutions to their challenges, and creating a positive experience from the very beginning.
You'll receive training on our software, implementation processes, and member experience standards, gradually taking on greater responsibility as you become familiar with our products and approach.
If you enjoy teaching others, solving problems, building relationships, and helping organizations succeed, this could be a great fit.
Location & Working Hours
This is a fully remote position open to candidates located in the United States or Canada.
Candidates must be available to work Pacific or Mountain Time Zone business hours, regardless of their physical location, to support our members effectively.
What You'll Do
Guide Members Through Implementation

• Work directly with new members to understand their goals, existing processes, and operational needs.

• Help members develop practical implementation strategies that align with their organization's priorities.

• Guide members through the implementation process, from initial onboarding through successful software adoption.

• Identify challenges, recommend solutions, and help members make informed decisions about how to configure and use the software.
Deliver Training and Build Confidence

• Lead engaging, accessible software training sessions for individuals and groups.

• Adapt your communication and teaching approach to different audiences, experience levels, and learning styles.

• Explain software features and workflows in ways that are clear, approachable, and relevant to each member's needs.

• Help members develop the knowledge and confidence to manage their software independently.
Create a Great Member Experience

• Build positive, professional relationships with members throughout their implementation journey.

• Maintain clear communication, manage expectations, and ensure members understand next steps.

• Introduce members to additional tools, resources, and services that may support their goals.

• Collaborate with colleagues across teams to resolve challenges and ensure a smooth member experience.
Contribute to Continuous Improvement

• Maintain accurate records of implementation activities, member progress, and follow-up needs.

• Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, training materials, and the overall member experience.

• Share member feedback and insights with internal teams to support ongoing improvements.
Requirements
We're interested in candidates who bring a combination of technical aptitude, strong communication skills, and a genuine interest in helping others succeed.
Qualifications

• Experience in a client-facing role, ideally within a SaaS or technology environment, such as implementation, customer success, onboarding, training, or operations.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to audiences with varying levels of experience.

title: PIP Claims Handler
description:
This is a remote position.
Position Summary:
We are seeking an experienced PIP Claims Handler to manage and investigate Personal Injury Protection (PIP) claims related to automotive accidents. This role is heavily focused on reviewing claims for accuracy, identifying inconsistencies, mitigating fraud exposure, and controlling claim costs while ensuring compliance with state regulations and policy requirements.
The ideal candidate has extensive experience handling PIP claims within the auto insurance, legal, healthcare billing, or claims administration space and is highly skilled at scrutinizing medical documentation, billing practices, and treatment timelines.
This position requires strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and confidence in challenging questionable claims, excessive billing, or unsupported treatment.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities (include, but are not limited to the following):
Key Responsibilities

• This role primarily handles PIP claims arising in Maryland, with regular exposure to Pennsylvania, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Virginia, and the District of Columbia. Familiarity with the regulatory frameworks in any of these states is strongly preferred; mastery of Maryland PIP is required

• Review, investigate, and manage PIP claims from initial notice through resolution

• Analyze medical records, treatment plans, billing submissions, police reports, and supporting documentation

• Identify billing irregularities, excessive treatment patterns, duplicate charges, inflated claims, or potential fraud indicators

• Evaluate claim validity and determine exposure based on applicable state PIP regulations and policy guidelines

• Defend against inaccurate, unsupported, or excessive claims through detailed file review and documentation

• Coordinate with attorneys, medical providers, adjusters, third-party administrators, and internal stakeholders

• Negotiate settlements and reductions with providers, attorneys, and claimants when appropriate

• Monitor claim timelines and ensure all statutory deadlines and compliance requirements are met

• Prepare detailed claim notes, summaries, and recommendations for leadership or legal review

• Assist with litigation support and respond to disputes, arbitrations, or audits related to PIP claims

• Identify trends and recommend process improvements to reduce claim leakage and financial exposure

• Maintain accurate claim files and documentation within internal systems

Qualifications Required:

• 3+ years of direct experience handling automotive PIP claims

• Strong knowledge of PIP regulations, medical billing review, and claims investigation practices

• Experience defending against questionable or inflated PIP claims

• Ability to interpret medical records, treatment documentation, and billing codes

• Experience in identifying fraud indicators, provider abuse, or claim inconsistencies

• Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to manage a high-volume caseload while maintaining accuracy

• Proficient in claims management systems and Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in rideshare, fleet, rental, or commercial auto claims environments

• Prior experience working with SIU (Special Investigations Unit) teams

• Familiarity with state-specific PIP regulations, especially high-volume PIP states

• Experience working with attorneys and litigation management

• Insurance adjuster license(s) where applicable

Salary: $65,000 - $70,000 per year; depending on experience
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, skeptical in the right ways, and comfortable challenging unsupported claims or questionable documentation. They should be able to balance thorough investigation with efficient claim handling and understand how to reduce unnecessary claim spend without compromising compliance or professionalism.

title: Head of Pricing & Monetization (m/f/d)
description:
About Babbel Labs

Babbel Labs is building the future of language learning. We're an AI-first, independent company within the Babbel group, based in Berlin. Our teams bring AI, R&D and product together to ship experiences that set a new standard for how people learn.

Your Learning Journey in This Role

We are looking for a Head of Pricing & Monetization to define and evolve Babbel’s pricing, packaging and monetization strategy. You will lead pricing decisions across existing and new products, including subscription plans, family plans, add-ons, trials and offers.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, with the opportunity to build a pricing function over time. You will work across Product, Growth, Marketing, Finance, Data and Engineering to turn customer insight and commercial analysis into pricing decisions that improve sustainable growth.

How You’ll Make an Impact

- Own Babbel’s pricing and monetization strategy across products, markets and customer segments, and develop the frameworks and processes behind it.

- Design pricing and packaging for new products and models, including subscription options, family plans and add-ons.

- Lead pricing decisions for existing plans, free trials, offers and customer segments, from analysis and modelling through to cross-functional alignment and launch.

- Establish clear principles for discounts, promotions and offers across Marketing and CRM, and improve pricing pages, checkout and subscription flows.

- Measure the impact of pricing decisions on revenue, conversion, retention and acquisition costs, using experimentation and analysis to continuously improve performance.

 

Your Skills and Qualifications

We think you’ll need the following experience to succeed in the role:

- Senior-level experience owning pricing or monetization in a fast-growing technology, subscription, digital product or consumer business.

- A proven track record of leading significant pricing or packaging changes end to end, from customer and market insight through to modelling, stakeholder alignment, launch and post-launch measurement.

- Experience building or scaling pricing capabilities, frameworks or ways of working, and partnering with Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, Finance and Data teams.

In addition, here are the skills and capabilities we’re looking for:

title: Senior Customer Support Service Delivery Program Manager

description:
In 1931, electrical draftsman Harry Beck looked at London’s Underground map and saw a system that had become too complicated to understand.

The maps at the time tried to represent the city geographically. Beck realized that wasn’t what riders actually needed. What mattered was how the system connected: which lines went where, where you could transfer, and the simplest way to get from one place to another. So he redrew the network around those relationships instead. His design became the foundation for the modern Tube map and changed how people navigated London.

Mercury’s Customer Experience organization has its own increasingly complex network.

As Mercury grows, the right place for support work will keep changing. Some new or complex work may benefit from starting in an incubation team before we know how it should scale. From there, it might move into Core Support, remain specialized, transition to an outsourced partner, or become increasingly supported by AI-powered tooling. The challenge is knowing where work belongs at each stage of its lifecycle, when it’s ready to move, and how to make those transitions without compromising the customer experience.

For the first 9-12 months, a significant majority of your work will focus on our growing BPO partnership. You’ll identify opportunities to expand the work we deliver through that partnership, build the operational and financial case for doing so, align CX leadership around those recommendations, and lead approved transitions from initial scoping through stabilization.

Over time, the scope will broaden. You’ll apply the same thinking across our wider service delivery ecosystem, helping us evaluate when work should enter an incubation model, when it is ready to graduate, and whether its next home should be Core Support, a specialized team, an outsourced partner, AI-powered tooling, or another model as our capabilities evolve.

You won’t be the sole decision-maker on where work lives. Your role is to develop the recommendation: bring together the data, customer impact, operational realities, and tradeoffs; build a compelling case; and help CX leadership reach a well-informed decision. Once a direction is approved, you’ll own the program that turns it into reality.

This is a role for someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution. You should be equally energized by building a strong argument for how our service delivery model should evolve and by working through the operational details required to make that change succeed.

In this role, you will:

• Lead high-impact programs that evolve how CX delivers support, with the first 9-12 months heavily focused on expanding and optimizing our BPO partnership.

• Identify opportunities to move work to a different service delivery model and build the case for change using customer, operational, and financial data. This could include recommending that emerging or complex work move into incubation, as well as determining when incubated work is mature enough to transition into Core Support, a specialized team, or our BPO partnership.

• Help define what makes work ready to move. Develop clear criteria for when a workflow needs incubation, when it has reached sufficient maturity and stability to graduate, and which delivery model is best positioned to own it next.

• Evaluate where AI-powered tooling could take on, augment, or reshape support work, and partner with the right teams to build a clear case for when automation creates a better customer and business outcome.

• Lead approved service delivery transitions end to end, whether work is moving into incubation, graduating from incubation, transitioning between internal teams, or moving to an outsourced partner. Own the program from initial scoping and business case through readiness, migration, ramp, stabilization, and handoff into long-term operations.

title: BSA/AML Officer - US
description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the backbone to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

THE JOB

You find risk, measure it and call it. You do not fix it.

Every finding you write answers three things: what is broken, how bad it is, and what evidence proves it. You don't soften the rating and you don't propose the remedy. The business owns the fix. You own the truth about the risk.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Test our BSA/AML, KYC, OFAC and transaction monitoring controls end to end, independently of the teams that run them

- Rate every finding (high / medium / low) with evidence that holds up in front of a regulator

- Pull and analyze data yourself; you don't wait for someone to send you a report

- Challenge thresholds, alert logic and sampling assumptions with numbers, not opinions

- Track open issues until owners close them, and escalate when they don't

- Prepare us for regulator exams and audits, and be the person in the room who already knows the weak spots

WHAT YOU NEED (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- 4+ years in BSA/AML, FinCrime, internal audit or regulatory compliance

- Experience at a top-tier audit/advisory firm, in-house compliance, or both. Both is ideal.

- You have written findings that a regulator, auditor or board actually read

- You can say "this is high risk" to a senior leader and point to the regulation which proves it.

- Deep working knowledge of the BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, OFAC and FinCEN expectations

NICE TO HAVE

- Law degree (JD) or bar admission

- Degree in engineering, mathematics, statistics or another STEM field

- SQL: you can query transaction data yourself

- Python or R for analysis, sampling or testing alert logic

- Statistics: sampling design, hypothesis testing, threshold and model validation

- CAMS, CRCM, CIA, CISA, CPA or CFE

- Exposure to AI or model risk (SR 11-7, NIST AI RMF)

YOU WILL NOT ENJOY THIS ROLE IF

- You need someone else to pull the data for you

- You round risk ratings down to keep people comfortable

- You are uncomfortable being the person no one wants in the meeting

- You uniform to the norm.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Data Curation & Dataset Strategy
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our datasets Team

Wayve's datasets team own the driving data that our AI Driver learns from, covering ingestion, annotation, retrieval and data quality. As our data grows from hundreds of petabytes towards exabyte scale, deciding what we keep, and where, is one of the biggest levers on both model quality and cost. This role sits at the centre of that challenge, shaping the data that model engineers train on across the company.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Build and own the ingestion-time model that scores incoming driving data and routes it to hot, cold, archive or delete

- Work with training teams to define the right data distributions for every model we're building

- Deliver early storage-cost savings through practical heuristics, then develop ML-driven filtering

- Partner with ingestion, annotation, retrieval, data quality, model training, AV/robotics, evaluation and storage teams to set company-wide data policy

- Lead and work hands-on with a small group of software and ML engineers to build data provisioning and data provenance features into Corpus

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Defining our dataset content strategy: which data and metadata we need, and why, so training teams can select the most valuable data as smoothly as possible

- Steering data selection by what our model engineers need right now. For example, if we're weak at unprotected right turns at traffic lights, those scenarios go straight to hot storage

- Delivering large, measurable storage-cost savings as ingestion scales across our internal fleet and partner and OEM data

- Evolving from practical heuristics to ML-driven filtering, and influencing what gets filtered at the vehicle and edge

- Working as a pair with our Corpus Implementation Engineer to turn strategy into production systems

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You have strong autonomous-vehicle or robotics experience, working with large-scale driving, sensor or comparable data

- You're a principal, hands-on ML engineer who has built models that score, select or filter data

title: Sr. Manager, Customer Success
description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve - we care.
What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.
Role Overview
Owns post-sale client implementations and ongoing account performance, ensuring successful onboarding, adoption, and measurable value realization. Serves as the primary client partner and internal coordinator, translating clinical and operational needs into effective product use and data-driven insights.

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end post-sale client success, from implementation through sustained performance.

• Lead complex client implementations and onboarding across cross-functional teams.

• Translate client workflows into effective product utilization and reporting solutions.

• Coordinate internal teams to align execution and resolve issues.

• Monitor account health, proactively managing risks and opportunities.

• Deliver against contractual, clinical, and performance commitments.

• Use patient-level and aggregate data to demonstrate outcomes and ROI.

• Lead client escalations to timely resolution with clear accountability.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients and an internal subject-matter resource.

Minimum Requirement
Degree or equivalent and typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience.
Critical Skills

• Minimum 7 years of experience in project management, preferably in a fast-paced or enterprise environment

• Significant experience in client implementation, account management, or customer success roles.

• Proven ability to independently manage complex, high-impact client engagements.

• Experience influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• Strong client-facing skills, including escalation and performance management.

• Project management, healthcare, analytics, or customer success certifications preferred.

Additional Skills

• Client implementation and account ownership

• Cross-functional leadership and influence

• Healthcare or pharmacy domain expertise

• Performance reporting and data-driven storytelling

• Risk management and escalation leadership

• Executive-level client communication

• Change management and adoption enablement

• Analytical problem-solving

• Prioritization in complex environments

• Continuous improvement mindset

• Anticipation of client and business needs

title: Praktikum M&A (Buy & Build/Private Equity) - Ab sofort / Q1 2027
description:
Wir sind ein Gründerteam (Backgrounds: HSG, ETH, BCG, Goldman Sachs) mit Track Record in Investments und Entrepreneurship. Im Zentrum unseres frisch gestarteten Private-Equity-Unternehmens bieten wir ein aussergewöhnliches Praktikum im Bereich Private Equity & Deal Execution. Dies ist deine Chance, direkt an der Analyse, Bewertung und Umsetzung von Transaktionen mitzuwirken, Seite an Seite mit unserem Deal Lead und den Mitgründern.
Aufgaben

Deal Sourcing & Screening: Identifikation, Ansprache und Erstbewertung potenzieller Zielunternehmen; Aufbau und Pflege einer strukturierten Deal-Pipeline
Financial Modeling: Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von LBO-Modellen (Kapitalstruktur, Financial Covenants, Returns-Analysen wie IRR/MOIC, Sensitivitäts- und Szenarioanalysen)
Due Diligence: Mitwirkung bei Commercial, Financial und Operational Due Diligence, inklusive Koordination mit externen Beratern (Wirtschaftsprüfer, Anwälte, Berater)
Investment Cases: Erstellung von Investment-Memoranden und Präsentationen für Investment Committees; Aufbereitung von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Unternehmensanalysen
Transaktionsprozess: Begleitung des gesamten Deal-Prozesses von Term Sheet über SPA-Verhandlungen bis Closing, inklusive Datenraum-Management
Post-Merger-Integration: Je nach Bedarf Unterstützung bei der Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) von akquirierten Unternehmen kann ebenfalls Teil der Aufgaben sein

Qualifikation

Verfügbarkeit für mindestens 6 Monate in Vollzeit
Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr gutes Verständnis von Finanzkennzahlen, Bilanzierung und Bewertungsmethoden
Erste Erfahrung in M&A, Private Equity, Investment Banking, Transaction Services oder Strategieberatung von Vorteil
Sehr gute Excel- und PowerPoint-Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit LBO-/D

title: Senior Compliance Analyst (Compliance Oversight Activities) - Remote
description:
At Prime Therapeutics (Prime), we are a different kind of PBM, with a purpose beyond profits and a unique ability to connect care for those we serve. Looking for a purpose-driven career? Come build the future of pharmacy with us.
Job Posting Title
Senior Compliance Analyst (Compliance Oversight Activities) - Remote Job Description
The Senior Compliance Analyst leads compliance initiatives within assigned areas and supports implementation of enterprise compliance programs. This role manages sensitive projects, serves as a subject matter expert, interprets complex requirements, develops executive reporting, and partners across the organization to support compliance oversight, including monitoring, issue management, corrective action governance, and regulatory compliance activities.

Responsibilities

• Lead compliance oversight activities including monitoring, reviews, issue management, and corrective action plan governance.

• Execute compliance procedures and enforce policy governance to validate regulatory reporting and operational requirements are met

• Serve as a compliance subject matter expert and develop solutions to highly complex issues and escalate findings as appropriate; enhance supporting documentation

• Represent Compliance on complex contracts and cross-functional projects and establish effective stakeholder partnerships

• Lead project management for highly sensitive or complex compliance initiatives and represent Compliance on cross-functional projects and contracts.

• Prepare clear and accurate compliance records, reporting and materials for senior leadership and governance committees

• Build effective relationships and influence stakeholders across organizational levels.

• Other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare, or related area of study, or equivalent combination of education and/or relevant work experience; HS diploma from an accredited school or equivalent GED required

• 5 years of progressive work experience in legal or compliance related roles for a healthcare or PBM organization, or other highly regulated industry, including experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and the Affordable Care Act (ACA)

Must be eligible to work in the United States without the need for work visa or residency sponsorship

Additional Qualifications

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

• Critical thinking and problem-solving skills for highly complex situations

• Comprehensive understanding of effective compliance program principles, practices, standards, industry challenges, and emerging approaches

• Ability to present complex information and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels

• Advanced organization and analytical skills with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Preferred Qualifications

• PBM or healthcare experience

• Certified Compliance and Ethics Professional (CCEP) or Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC)

• Project Management Professional (PMP)

• Medicare Part B Drug & Part D, Medicaid, and/or Affordable Care Act experience

Every employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the job and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship.
